subject: English
question_text: Suppose, your friend Rana/Rina lives in a village and you
stimulus: Fardin/Fariha live in a town. Now, write a dialogue between you and your friend about the advantages and disadvantages of village life and city life. 10 Subject Code : 1 0 7 practiced in practical life. Only good words cannot make a good character, words and deeds together make a man's character. A man of character must be honest, truthful, polite, gentle, amicable, dutiful and respectful to other people. He must not have any jealously, hatred and evil feelings. He must love all. He must perform his duties to self and society. That is why, a man of character should have a strong sense of patriotism. He must check all evil sentiments and false vanity. Fellow feelings, friendship, love for mankind, respect for opposite sex, sense of proportion and balance− these are also Board & Test Questions : First Paper some other characteristics of a man of good character. He must have a good heart and a balanced mind. The major hurdles in the way of becoming a man of good character are evil passions and tendencies, prejudice, superstition and selfishness. These bad traits must be kept in check. It would be better if those bad traits could be killed. However, the importance of good character can be best illustrated by the following sentences : "If wealth is lost, nothing is lost If health is lost, something is lost If character is lost, everything is lost."
